entry.title: v12.2.0
entry.content:
v12.2.0 (2026-10-19)

Notable changes

New options

  • @Sse({ maxPendingDataLength }) sets how many characters of event data may wait for a client that is not reading its events (4M by default; 0 or Infinity lifts the limit) – 2f05ad954e
  • IoAdapter and WsAdapter take maxConcurrentMessages, the number of a client's messages handled at once (1000 by default; Infinity lifts it) – 0bd0810ed7
  • ValidationPipe takes maxErrorMessagesLength (1,000,000 characters by default); messages past it are replaced by a "Further validation errors were omitted" entry – 086c1c514f
  • Kafka: parser.maxMessageSize (16 MiB after decompression by default); larger messages are logged and skipped – 9bdf844fca
  • TCP server: drainTimeout (30 s by default, 0 disables) disconnects a peer that leaves its responses unread – 583d6077ad
  • MQTT server: reconnectOnConnackError is now enabled by default, so a refused connection attempt is retried; set it to false for the previous behaviour – a63cea600a
  • HttpServer.getRouteMatchingOptions(), an optional adapter hook that tells core how the router matches paths (see "Middleware exclusions" below) – 08d8677c8d

New defaults and behaviour changes

  • @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/platform-fastify: fieldNestingDepth and fieldArrayIndexLimit (#18074) now default to 32 and 1000; set them to Infinity to lift the limits – 94fcc93770
  • ValidationPipe validates with validationError.target: false unless the options set it, so an exceptionFactory that reads error.target gets undefined; set validationError.target to true for the old errors – 8c5a59bf63
  • ValidationPipe answers an array or a primitive sent for a validated class with a 400 – 197371c1f3
  • FileTypeValidator matches a string fileType up to the end of a name (e.g. font/woff no longer accepts font/woff2; use a RegExp for that) – 770c6f1a19
  • @SerializeOptions({}) on a handler no longer turns off the class schema – d27cb7017f
  • BaseExceptionFilter answers http-errors errors created with expose: false (the default from 500) with the standard reason phrase instead of their message – 9ed572f853
  • A StreamableFile error still gets a 400, but the body no longer carries the error message – 2f28d91afb
  • Files uploaded with a request that a pipe rejected are removed from storage – acb98de89e
  • @nestjs/platform-fastify: a route with fileSize: undefined (or null) falls back to the plugin's limit; set it to Infinity to keep uploads unlimited – dd549e1a74
  • @nestjs/platform-express: object error bodies are sent as application/json on routes with a non-JSON Content-Type – 7dc6e349d5
  • ConsoleLogger in JSON mode cuts a record short past about a million characters – ad4915eaa3
  • A global enhancer that the injector failed to instantiate now fails the application at startup – ae78524ced
  • A request- or transient-scoped APP_FILTER now logs a startup warning, as it only applies to exceptions thrown from controllers – df5275c5e1
  • Microservices: a pattern key longer than 256 characters matches no handler – accd27e66c
  • Kafka: a message may carry up to 10,000 header values (e419ff540b); headers given as a string or array are not sent (312777743f); reply headers are decoded as text (ee94f6aaae)
  • gRPC: request streams are paused while their replies wait to be written – 37e5cf7706
  • Deprecation: on TCP, Redis, NATS, MQTT and RabbitMQ, an @EventPattern() handler that replies to ClientProxy#send() now logs a deprecation warning. The reply is unchanged; in the next major version event handlers will not reply to send(), as on Kafka already – ba3668d36b

Middleware exclusions

  • MiddlewareConsumer.exclude() now compiles excluded routes with the router's case and trailing-slash matching (08d8677c8d). Update @nestjs/core together with @nestjs/platform-express / @nestjs/platform-fastify: with an adapter that does not implement getRouteMatchingOptions(), excluded routes are matched exactly (f5aa875e40), so on a lenient router other spellings of an excluded path run the middleware.
  • With header, media type or custom versioning, exclude({ path, method, version }) and enableCsrfProtection({ exclude }) apply only to requests that ask for one of the excluded versions – 1a7a31fa46
  • @nestjs/platform-fastify: the request hook used by enableCsrfProtection() and useSecurityHeaders() now runs before Nest and app.use() middleware with NestFactory.create() too, including middleware registered before either call, as it already did with Test.createNestApplication() – 8351806290

Bug fixes

  • platform-fastify
    • 614d1ac7ea fix(fastify): send the status of an exception whose body is an error (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 8b420f788f fix(fastify): apply middleware to plugins registered before init (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • #18175 fix(fastify): keep raw-response cookies in the header helpers (@johnnyhuirilef)
    • c215fd9b4f fix(fastify): match middleware paths like a case-insensitive router (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 43d4420205 fix(fastify): pass version extractor errors to the error handler (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 1435ed22f4 fix(fastify): pass middleware rejections to the error handler (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 84c947faf9 fix(fastify): stop reading a streamable file for a head request (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • dd549e1a74 fix(fastify): let undefined upload limits fall back to the defaults (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 4735f8d050 fix(fastify): free memory storage chunks once a file is buffered (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • 3e3e6eea6f fix(fastify): remove uploads cut off after their last chunk (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • c04a9182b9 fix(fastify): set the security headers on router error responses (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • a03c7a1db6 fix(fastify): answer request targets that are not a path with 404 (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • #18156 fix(fastify): apply route options to all-method routes (@Ahmad-Mosha)
  • microservices
    • #18182 fix(microservices): handle malformed kafka reply assigner member metadata (@SssiiiSssii1)
    • 83a55aa9dc fix(microservices): leave the init hooks to the hybrid application (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • ffd27afe10 fix(microservices): call the init hooks once when init() is called (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • #18179 fix(microservices): preserve request order during deferred replay (@Benziza)

entry.title: v12.1.3
entry.content:
v12.1.3 (2026-10-12)

Bug fixes

  • core, microservices
    • #18111 fix(core,microservices): flush buffered logs when initialization fails (@thekhegay)
    • #17993 fix(core,microservices): run transient global enhancers on controllers (@johnnyhuirilef)
  • platform-express
    • #18110 fix(express): guard async request hook completion (@GiHoon1123)
    • #17973 fix(express): destroy the StreamableFile source on client disconnect (@maxymlyskov)
    • #17942 fix(express): run wildcard middleware on the bare global prefix path (@Chaoqi31)
  • core
    • #18104 fix(core): fail at startup for request-scoped class global enhancers (@thekhegay)
    • #18066 fix(core): stop silently dropping request-scoped global enhancers (@OmBhandwaldar)
    • #18072 fix(core): resolve uri versioned exclusions for the not-found handler (@basteez)
    • #18075 fix(core): normalize slashes when mapping controllers for middleware (@basteez)
    • #18086 fix(core): do not mutate the message when assigning an sse event id (@Metehan-Bicer)
    • #18025 fix(core): end sse streams whose event data cannot be serialized (@OmBhandwaldar)
    • #18011 fix(core): send status and headers set by handlers on sse responses (@johnnyhuirilef)
    • #18021 fix(core): honor a shutdown signal received while close() is in flight (@maxymlyskov)
    • #17987 fix(core): settle SSE lifecycle on early disconnect (@jackie-cqz)
    • #17986 fix(core): commit SSE headers for empty streams (@jackie-cqz)
    • #17978 fix(core): preserve explicit null values in reflectable decorators (@gophersg)
    • #17966 fix(core): run the shutdown sequence after a failed init (@kamilmysliwiec)
    • #17963 fix(core): send the expires header on sse responses (@Mohamed-Elshesheny)

  • microservices

    • #18083 fix(microservices): match rmq '#' wildcards in any position (@thekhegay)

    • #18081 fix(microservices): close the connection when the channel close fails (@hktitof)
